final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and checking if its level is ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). For those entries, I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required format, extracted the service, level (upper case), message, and the last line of the traceback if present as the exception. I also summed the repeat counts from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. Finally, I aggregated counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure.
